title: Prediction: Synopsys Could Become the Next $150 Billion Software Giant
excerpt: Synopsys has cratered over 40% in the past year while its underlying business just posted 42% revenue growth, and that contradiction is exactly where a gener...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • SNPS earns a BUY with a $471 price target implying 26% upside, even as shares have fallen 41% over the past 12 months.

  • Synopsys guides to $9.7B in revenue at a $72B market cap, a steep valuation discount to Cadence's $93B cap on far less revenue.

  • The five-year bull case projects $1,275 per share and a $200B market cap, contingent on Ansys synergies and agentic EDA adoption scaling.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Synopsys didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Shares of Synopsys (NASDAQ:SNPS) have declined in 2026, prompting a fresh look at valuation. Our 24/7 Wall St. price target for Synopsys is $471.37, implying 26.14% upside from the current price of $373.69.

The recommendation is buy at a confidence level of 90%. Extended to a five-year horizon, our base case points to a share price that would push Synopsys past a $140 billion market cap and within striking distance of the $150 billion tier.

Why Synopsys Sold Off Into a Buying Zone

Synopsys has fallen 20.44% year to date and 41.23% over the past 12 months, trading 13% below the 52-week high of $646.28 and near the 52-week low of $366.

The operating story keeps improving. Q2 FY2026 revenue of $2.276 billion rose 42% and non-GAAP EPS of $3.35 beat the $3.16 consensus. Management raised full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance to a midpoint of $14.76 and free cash flow to $2 billion.

CEO Sassine Ghazi said "AI is scaling semiconductor demand, architectural diversity, and complexity of both chips and the systems they power, driving increased demand across our portfolio."

The Case for $600 and a $150B Market Cap

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Synopsys didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

The bull thesis rests on three pillars. First, Ansys integration is unlocking joint offerings neither company could sell alone. Multiphysics fusion is delivering "up to 3x faster design closure" in trials, with a $400 million semiconductor multiphysics synergy target starting in FY2027.

Second, agentic EDA is a live monetization inflection: 20 customers are evaluating solutions across more than 25 specialized AI agents, and management is layering consumption pricing on top of seats.

Third, IP is recovering, with PCIe 7.0 winning greater than 90% of deals and 18 new licenses booked in Q2.

Our 12-month bull case sits at $638.01, and the five-year bull case reaches $1,275.10, which would push Synopsys well past $200 billion in market cap.

content_html_zh:
快速阅读

  • SNPS 获得买入评级，目标价为 471 美元，意味着上涨 26%，尽管该股在过去 12 个月内下跌了 41%。
  • Synopsys 预计营收为 9.7B 美元，市值为 72B 美元，相对于收入少得多的 Cadence 的 93B 美元上限而言，估值存在大幅折扣。
  • 五年牛市预测每股 1,275 美元，市值 200B 美元，具体取决于 Ansys 协同效应和代理 EDA 采用规模。
  • 立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Synopsys 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

Synopsys（纳斯达克股票代码：SNPS）的股价在 2026 年有所下跌，促使人们重新审视估值。 我们对 Synopsys 的 24/7 华尔街目标价为 471.37 美元，这意味着较当前价格 373.69 美元上涨 26.14%。

建议以 90% 的置信度买入。 展望五年，我们的基本假设表明，新思科技的股价将突破 1,400 亿美元的市值，距离 1,500 亿美元的市值不远了。

为什么新思科技 (Synopsys) 被抛售至买入区

新思科技今年迄今已下跌 20.44%，过去 12 个月下跌 41.23%，较 52 周高点 646.28 美元低 13%，接近 52 周低点 366 美元。

运营故事不断改善。 2026 财年第二季度营收为 22.76 亿美元，增长 42%，非 GAAP 每股收益为 3.35 美元，超出市场预期 3.16 美元。 管理层将全年非 GAAP 每股收益指引上调至 14.76 美元的中点，并将自由现金流上调至 20 亿美元。

首席执行官 Sassine Ghazi 表示：“人工智能正在扩大半导体需求、架构多样性以及芯片及其驱动系统的复杂性，推动我们产品组合的需求增加。”

600 美元和 150B 美元市值的案例

立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Synopsys 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

牛市论点基于三个支柱。 首先，Ansys 集成正在释放两家公司都无法单独销售的联合产品。 多物理场融合正在试验中实现“设计收敛速度提高 3 倍”，从 2027 财年开始，半导体多物理场协同目标将达到 4 亿美元。

其次，代理 EDA 是一种实时货币化变形：20 个客户正在评估超过 25 个专业 AI 代理的解决方案，管理层正在对席位进行分层消费定价。

第三，IP 正在复苏，PCIe 7.0 赢得了超过 90% 的交易，并在第二季度获得了 18 个新许可证。

我们的 12 个月牛市预测为 638.01 美元，五年牛市预测为 1,275.10 美元，这将使 Synopsys 的市值远远超过 2000 亿美元。
